home.headline: Who paid what—and who owes whom
home.sub: For trips, roommates, and gatherings. Add expenses together, and AAEasy works out everyone’s balance.
home.feature_capture_desc: Capture the expense, payer, and split in one go.
home.feature_collab_desc: Everyone can contribute, with changes kept in sync.
home.feature_balance_desc: See who owes and who gets paid back.

admin.bypass_banner: You are viewing this ledger as a Super Admin override. You are not a member — changes will be attributed to your account.
admin.all_ledgers_desc: Every ledger in the system. Open any to view or edit as Super Admin; deleted ledgers are shown for reference only.

account.title: Account settings
account.identity_managed_by: Your identity and sign-in methods are managed by Pangda Auth.
account.identity_desc: AAEasy reads this profile from Pangda Auth. Update it there to keep one identity across applications.
account.delete_desc: Permanently delete your AAEasy data, all owned groups, and their contents. Your Pangda account is not deleted.
account.delete_warning: This action is irreversible. Your AAEasy data will be permanently deleted.
account.delete_owned_warning: You own {count} group(s). These will be deleted with your AAEasy data:
account.delete_no_owned: You don't own any groups. Deleting your AAEasy data only removes your access; groups owned by others are unaffected.
account.delete_transfer_hint: You can transfer OWNER rights to other linked members before deleting your account.

groups.empty: You haven't created any groups yet. Create one to start tracking expenses.
groups.empty_desc: Create one for your next trip, gathering, or shared home.
groups.name: Name
groups.initial_members_chip_hint: Type names separated by comma or Enter; or @username to invite
groups.chip_mention_hint: Comma (, or ，) and Enter both separate names; start with @ to invite an AAEasy user; click × to remove
groups.chip_unresolved_mention: No user found with that username — added as a placeholder name
groups.confirm_delete: This cannot be undone. Delete the entire group?
groups.archived_banner: This group is archived, so expenses can’t be added or edited. Payments can still be recorded under Settle up. The owner can reopen it from Members & settings.
groups.transfer_no_candidates: No eligible recipients (must be a linked member)
groups.transfer_owner_desc: Choose a linked member to own this group. You’ll become a manager.
groups.delete_desc: Permanently delete this group and all its data. This action cannot be undone.
groups.leave_desc: Leaving immediately revokes your access to this group and cannot be undone by you. The group and its history are unaffected.
groups.confirm_leave: Leave this group? You will immediately lose access and cannot restore it yourself.

members.title: Members
members.confirm_remove: Remove this member? Members with expense records cannot be removed.
members.confirm_unlink: Unlink this member from their account? The user will lose the ability to act as this member; the member and their expense records are unaffected.

expenses.title: Expenses
expenses.empty: No expenses yet. Record your first one to get started.
expenses.empty_desc: Add the first expense. It starts as an equal split, and you can adjust it before saving.
expenses.form_intro: For a typical equal split, you only need the amount, what it was for, and who paid. Adjust special splits below.
expenses.form_intro_edit: Balances are recalculated automatically when you save your changes.
expenses.draft_mode_hint: Skip the amount and split for now — the payer can fill them in from the group page.
expenses.ai_placeholder: e.g. Lunch with Alice and Bob yesterday, 87.50 USD, I paid
expenses.ai_hint: AI will pre-fill the form. Review before saving.
expenses.ai_use_image_confirm: Use this image as AI context to pre-fill the form?
expenses.ai_image_too_large: Image is too large for AI context (max 3MB)
expenses.ai_receipt_dialog_desc: AI can read this receipt and pre-fill the form. You can review everything before saving.
expenses.ai_receipt_prompt_text: Please read the uploaded receipt image and pre-fill the expense form.
expenses.ai_placeholder_edit: e.g. change amount to 100, split between Alice and me
expenses.ai_unresolved_payer: Couldn't find member "{name}" — payer left unchanged
expenses.drafts_to_fill: {count, plural, one {# draft to fill} other {# drafts to fill}}
expenses.drafts_hint: Type the amount paid for each item. Saving converts the draft into a regular expense, split equally among all members.
expenses.draft_filled_count: {count, plural, one {# draft saved} other {# drafts saved}}
expenses.reopen_desc: Reopen this group to add and edit expenses again.

summary.title: Balances
summary.trail_title_pending: {count, plural, one {# transfer left} other {# transfers left}} to settle up
summary.trail_desc: AAEasy has worked out the current balances from expenses and recorded transfers.

settlements.title: Settle up
settlements.pending_desc: Follow the steps below. Each recorded payment updates what remains immediately.
settlements.settle_confirm_desc: This locks {count} expenses and archives the group. Expenses can’t be added or edited, but transfers can still be recorded. The owner can reopen it later.
settlements.settle_draft_warning: {count, plural, one {# unfinished draft will be deleted.} other {# unfinished drafts will be deleted.}}
settlements.reopen_confirm: Reopening allows expense tracking again and removes the current archive record. Continue?
settlements.recorded_count: {count, plural, one {# transfer record} other {# transfer records}}
settlements.record_disclaimer: AAEasy records transfers; it does not move money.
settlements.confirm_delete_entry: Delete this transfer record? The amount will no longer be deducted from balances.

export.title: Export
export.failed: Couldn't export the ledger — please try again

share.title: Share links
share.group_share_desc: Create view-only links for the whole ledger. These links never bind to an account.
share.group_dialog_desc: Anyone with this link can view the ledger only. They cannot bind an account or make changes.
share.bind_hint: To bind an account to a specific member, head over to Settings.
share.dialog_desc: Generate share links for this member. Visitors using a link act as them in this group.
share.expired_read_only_notice: This link has expired. You can view the group, but not make any changes.
share.confirm_revoke: Revoke this link? Already-shared URLs will stop working immediately.
share.claim_prompt: Are you {name}? Confirming will link this account to that member.
share.member_already_linked: This member is already linked to an account. New share links are disabled.
share.link_one_time_warning: This link is shown only once — copy it now, you won't see it again.

binding.method_invite_desc: Faster for someone who already has an account — they get the invitation in their groups list and can accept or reject.
binding.method_link_desc: Better when the person hasn't used AAEasy yet, or when you want to send the invite over chat / social media.
binding.confirm_cancel: Cancel this invitation? The recipient will no longer see it.

invitations.confirm_reject_all: Reject all {count} pending invitations? This cannot be undone.
invitations.accepted_toast: {count, plural, one {# invitation accepted} other {# invitations accepted}}
invitations.rejected_toast: {count, plural, one {# invitation rejected} other {# invitations rejected}}
